intro.text: A bright green bird that can mimic human speech.

items.text: A Thaylen man was showing the bird at the Middlefest Fair when Shallan saw it. She had never seen such a "chicken", and when its owner had it say its name on command she was shocked and accused it of being a Voidbringer.

appearance.text: About two fists tall, with sleek green plumage, he perches in his cage on clawed feet and studies people with a noticeable personality.
